headline: Review of alterations at 32 Thomas Street by Jeremy Benn and Williston, LLC.
summary: A workshop covers alterations at 32 Thomas Street, which had a site visit set for a later date. The agenda also reports that 43 St. Lawrence Street was approved 6 to 0.
